title: Roll With Advantage: Helpful Bits
description: A grab-bag of quality-of-life tweaks for running D&D 5e (2024 rules) in Foundry: an alphabetized, labelled condition picker on the Token HUD, condition rules posted to chat when a condition is applied, automatic token animations for conditions, and per-player Hunter's Mark status effects.

recommends.reason: Used to play looping JB2A animations on tokens that have a condition.
Provides the animation files used by the default condition animations.
Optional fallback: token filters (glow, blur, desaturate) for conditions that have no animation file.
